title: The repository is public
decision: The repository was made public on 2026-10-08 so that CI runs without a spending limit. The agent told the founder what becomes readable by anyone: the security review with its open findings, the business documents and decisions, and the code, which carries no licence; and that copies made while it is public cannot be recalled
context: Answered by the founder on 2026-10-08 when asked by the agent in the working session
rationale: CI had stopped on the account's billing and the founder preferred this to paying or to a runner on the office computer
